objective: Let the owner pick eBook cover or Software box, preview an AI cover and choose Use this image on a draft.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Create src/app/dashboard/ai-cover-generator.tsx and change src/app/dashboard/draft-review.tsx exactly as specified in the acceptance test header, following the existing DescriptionGenerator component in src/app/dashboard/description-generator.tsx (shown) and how draft-review.tsx renders it.

Change draft-review.tsx with three small anchored edits (several edits to one file are allowed and apply in order): insert the AiCoverGenerator import after the line `import { DescriptionGenerator } from "./description-generator";`, insert the onUse handler before the line `  async function downloadSource() {`, and insert the rendered generator before the `Reviewed title` label line. Do not replace large blocks.

Exports used from @/lib/ai-cover (not shown, must not change): export const AI_COVER_STYLES = ["ebook", "software_box"] as const; export type AiCoverStyle = (typeof AI_COVER_STYLES)[number]; export const AI_COVER_STYLE_LABELS: Readonly<Record<AiCoverStyle, string>> ("eBook cover", "Software box").

/api/cover replies (all JSON): GET ?item=<id>&style=<style> returns { enabled, reason, saved } where reason is ready, paused, expired, limit or saved; POST { item_id, style } returns { saved } or { error } with status 409. saved is { status, style, object_path?, sha256? }; only status "generated" with object_path has an image. A saved "reserved" attempt has no image and must never be retried automatically.

Preview with next/image (unoptimized) from an object URL of the downloaded private image, revoked when replaced or unmounted. In draft-review.tsx, use the existing sha256Hex helper and the saved title and description (not unsaved edits) for the new metadata hash; disable the generator while the review has unsaved edits or a transition is pending.
No server, API, database schema or storage policy changes; the browser never uploads images. Keep the change small: one new component and a focused edit to draft-review.tsx.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (122 files, 750325 bytes); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
